resources.string: Android 11+ requires folder access to view statuses. Click below and tap \"Use this folder\" to grant permission.
Open WhatsApp, view recent friend statuses, and they will automatically appear here!
Save statuses to your Gallery to see them here anytime, even after 24 hours.
This status will be permanently removed from your saved gallery.
WhatsApp is not installed on this device
1. Open WhatsApp or WhatsApp Business and view your contacts\' statuses.
2. Return to Status Saver. All viewed images and videos will automatically appear in their respective tabs.
3. Tap any status thumbnail to view it full-screen. Swipe left and right to browse all statuses without going back!
4. Tap the Save button to save directly to your phone\'s Gallery, or tap Repost / Share to post directly to your own status or social apps.
5. Long-press any item to enter multi-select mode to save or share multiple statuses at once.

Effective Date: November 2026

1. Information Collection & Use
Status Saver does not collect, harvest, store, or transmit any personal information, photos, videos, or contact details to external servers. All status viewing and saving operations occur entirely on your local device.

2. Device Permissions
Our application requests Storage and Storage Access Framework (SAF) folder permissions strictly to read temporary WhatsApp status files and save selected files directly to your device's local Gallery (Pictures/StatusSaver and Movies/StatusSaver).

3. Advertising & Third-Party SDKs
This application displays advertisements powered by the Unity Ads SDK. Unity Ads may collect anonymous device diagnostics, IP address, and advertising identifiers according to Unity's Privacy Policy (https://unity.com/legal/privacy-policy) to deliver relevant ad experiences.

4. Contact Us
If you have questions regarding this Privacy Policy, please contact our support team.

1. Intellectual Property & User Conduct
Status Saver is an independent utility application designed to help users preserve and manage media locally. Users are solely responsible for ensuring they have the necessary rights or explicit permission from original content creators before downloading, reposting, or redistributing any photos, videos, or audio.

2. Non-Affiliation Disclaimer
Status Saver is an independent application and is not affiliated with, authorized, maintained, sponsored, or endorsed by WhatsApp LLC, WhatsApp Business, Meta Platforms, Inc., or any of their affiliates.

3. Disclaimer of Warranties
The service is provided on an "AS IS" and "AS AVAILABLE" basis without warranties of any kind.
